record_title: Plane counts control subalgebra commutativity in dimension three
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Muhie--Otera--Russo (arXiv:2609.19086v1) introduced the subalgebra commutativity degree and computed the three-dimensional Heisenberg and odd-characteristic sl2 examples; Towers--Zuleta--Gutierrez (arXiv:2605.09583) classified the three-dimensional comaximal graph and already obtained the relevant solvable plane counts. Those results are prior work. The novelty claim is restricted to the universal plane-count formulas for sd and F2, the equivalence with lattice cardinality, the complete four-value classification over every finite field, and the classification-free perfect-case q+1 plane theorem. The modular-pairs paper is a recent v1 and may be revised or independently extended. No claim is made in dimensions greater than three. No independent validation is asserted.
